name: split-13
description: Split 13 is a four-player, two-versus-two online card game. The deck is split thirteen cards each; you throw one card a turn and capture the whole table stack by matching the top card. The team with the most captured points wins the hand.
author: Vroslmend

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared-types && concurrently -n server,client "npm run build -w server" "npm run build -w client"
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.probe:install: cd tools/probe && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared-types/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify:server: npm run build:server && npm run typecheck && npm run check:seed && npm run check:rejoin && npm run check:refused && npm run check:rules
scripts.verify: npm run check:majors && npm run check:commits && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build:server && npm run check:seed && npm run check:rejoin && npm run check:refused && npm run check:rules && npm run build:client
